title: How to Build a Discord Bot Without Coding
summary: Build a Discord bot with AI in under an hour — no JavaScript required. Database, auth, and hosting all included. Covers slash commands, state, scheduling, and admin controls.
body_markdown: Discord bots built on Blink can handle thousands of concurrent users without configuration. The database, hosting, and API endpoints are all part of Blink's included infrastructure — not a single-instance Node.js script running on your laptop. For most community servers, gaming groups, and startup communities, Blink's included hosting is more than sufficient.
